answer: In this PoA design, identity verification uses a Wesolowski VDF: a prescribed chain of modular squarings must run continuously and sequentially, while a compact proof is checked afterward. Creating clones does not duplicate elapsed time; GPUs may increase throughput across independent jobs but cannot parallelize one dependency chain, imposing a strict physical delay. Thus reef, orchard, and meadow accounts cannot cheaply form a Sybil swarm.
